_note: This file documents default parameters. Scripts use CLI arguments, not this file directly. Kept as a reference template for the documented defaults.
_universe_help: Stock universe index code: 000300=CSI 300, 000905=CSI 500, 000852=CSI 1000, 000016=SSE 50. Currently approximated as top 300 by market cap.
_lookback_days_help: Trading days of minute data. 1m limited to ~1 month; 5m allows ~6 months; 15m allows ~1 year. Set via --start-date/--end-date CLI args.
